regions.label: iNES_Header
regions.evidence: 16-byte iNES header: magic NES\x1a, PRG 8x16KiB, CHR 16x8KiB, flags mapper 1 horizontal mirroring (romatlas inspect).

regions.label: CHR_4K_00
regions.evidence: CHR ROM 4 KiB page 0 (file 0x20010-0x2100F): iNES header declares 128 KiB CHR ROM at file offset 0x20010 (romatlas inspect chr_offset/chr_size); mapper 1 (MMC1) maps it only into PPU pattern tables, so all bytes are 2bpp tile pattern data (16 bytes/tile, 256 tiles per page). The game writes both MMC1 CHR registers separately (MMC1_WriteChr0 $EF25 / MMC1_WriteChr1 $EF39), consistent with 4 KiB CHR switching. Individual tile use not enumerated.
